name: improve-codebase-architecture
description: Find deepening opportunities informed by domain language and ADRs. Consolidate modules, improve testability.

steps.name: Explore
steps.instruction: Agent(Explore) to walk codebase. Read glossary + ADRs first.

steps.name: Present candidates
steps.instruction: HTML report to OS temp dir (Tailwind + Mermaid CDN). Before/after card per candidate. Open for user, ask which to explore.
checklist: HTML report with before/after cards written to temp dir

steps.name: Deepen
steps.instruction: Spawn 3+ parallel agents with different constraints (minimize interface, maximize flexibility, common caller, ports & adapters). Align constraints with constraint-sheet dimensions. New term -> GLOSSARY.md. Rejected candidate with reason -> offer ADR.
checklist: Multiple alternatives explored, aligned with constraint sheet
GLOSSARY.md updated if new terms, ADR offered if rejected with reason

steps.name: Record decisions
steps.instruction: Write proposals with concrete file paths and interface changes. Record ADRs with constraint-sheet structure and revisit trigger.
checklist: ADRs recorded with constraint sheet structure + revisit trigger

tone: Observational. Report what you find, propose what you would change.
